metadata.purpose: Persistent exclusions for the 18 buildings removed on 2026-10-09 from the latest committed apartment list.
metadata.scope: Exactly the building IDs present in the baseline commit and absent from the working directory. Older exclusions already absent from that commit are outside this file’s initial scope.
metadata.readdition_policy: Before adding or merging any building into apartments.json, check generation-rules/excluded-apartments.json by id, current or previous name, address and property website. Do not automatically re-add a matching building, including under a new name or ID. Reinstatement requires an explicit user decision and a documented update to this registry; newly found prices or amenities alone do not override the exclusion.
metadata.reason_date_note: Reasons describe the evidence and user decisions on the exclusion date, not newly researched current availability.
